index.title: Stories
index.description: Three guided walks through India's economy in 2023-24, with every figure taken from the balanced accounts and labelled by how it was made.
index.lede: Each story follows one flow of money through the economy, step by step, with the map beside it. Every figure comes from the data and carries a label saying whether it is official, derived, estimated or set when the accounts were balanced.
index.honesty: The stories describe one year, 2023-24, as the accounts record it. They use average shares, not forecasts or multipliers: what happens when one more rupee arrives is a question for the next phase of this project.
